scores.label: A
scores.note: Layers, sealing drafts, one warm room, warns against cooking stove for heat; no CO alarm or generator warning; electric heater useless without power.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Layers and fireplace right, but no CO warning at all, no oven/stove/generator warning; suggests electric heater with power out.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Recommends oven/stove baking to warm home, generator for space heater, candles for warmth; directly contradicts CO guidance.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Layers, close interior doors right; no CO warning, no oven/generator warning; vague 'portable stove' as heat source; confusing water-bottle item.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Layers, CO detectors, no generator indoors right; but advises indoor gas/kerosene heaters and gas grill cooking.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Layers right; first advice is generators, propane, kerosene heaters indoors 'well-ventilated'; no never-indoors or CO alarm guidance.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Advises oven/stovetop to warm home and generator for space heater; confuses carbon dioxide with CO; contradicts guidance.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Layers, never generator, never gas stove/oven, never charcoal grill indoors; but promotes indoor propane/kerosene heaters; no CO alarm.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Layers, blankets, no generators indoors, avoid candles right; no oven/stove warning or CO alarm; humidifier and car-warming tips irrelevant.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Shelter in basement or interior room, stay inside, follow officials right; no 24-hour period, no removing clothing/washing.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Emphasizes getting far from blast and evacuating over sheltering; vehicle as shelter; decontamination mentioned; no 24-hour stay.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Interior room lowest floor, stay informed right; false claim contamination visible as lights/odors; boiled water myth; no decontamination.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Get inside, stay until all-clear, listen to officials right; odd 'cover with table' and 'no dust mask' advice; no clothing removal.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Get indoors, basement or interior room, follow alerts right; no 24-hour stay, no clothing removal; cluttered with prep lists.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Basement mentioned but advises ditch, getting under vehicle, turning off water to reduce radiation; nonsense exposure-duration guidance.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Decontamination and staying indoors right, but tells outdoor people to move 1-2 miles away; odd advice to avoid children/pregnant women.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Basement or center room, stay inside, official info right; no 24 hours or decontamination; photo-documenting incident is irrelevant.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Shelter in building, stay indoors, decontaminate by showering right; no basement/middle or 24-hour guidance; vehicle shelter weak.

scores.label: J
scores.note: Get inside and basement right, but tells outdoor people to move to open area; false claim sodium-rich foods protect against radiation.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Identifies heatstroke, cools with ice packs and fanning; gives fluids to confused person and delays 911 until worsening.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Cooling and shade right; no immediate 911, gives fluids, does not treat these signs as heat stroke emergency.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Calls 911 right, but mislabels heat exhaustion, forbids cold water and ice packs, and gives water to confused person.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Names heat stroke, cools with water and fanning, calls 911; but 911 is step 6 and offers fluids when confused.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Cooling with cold packs right; 911 only conditional despite confusion already present; gives fluids; does not name heat stroke.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Gives fluids, checks thermometer before calling; 911 conditional; cooling only compresses on pulse points, no fast cooling.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Names heat stroke, cooling with ice packs right; no immediate 911, gives fluids, 'cool not cold' slows cooling.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Frames as dehydration, encourages drinking, warns against cooling too quickly; 911 only if heat stroke suspected.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Names heatstroke, ice packs, wet sheets, fanning; final step says call EMS if confused; still offers fluids, 911 comes late.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Bulging, swollen, off odor, symptoms listed right; implies tasting ('tastes unusual'); disposal vague, no bleach or sealed bags.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Bulging, off smell, do not taste, symptoms right; misses leaking, foam, cloudy liquid; no safe disposal or bleach.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Bulging, foaming, odor, leaks, symptoms right; no explicit never-taste; no sealed-bag disposal or bleach cleanup.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Swollen, off odor, never taste, discard right; misses leaking, foam, spurting; no safe disposal or symptom care.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Bulging, leaking, odor, toxin may be invisible, symptoms right; 'if food tastes bad' implies tasting; no bleach cleanup.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Bulging, leaking, hissing, odor, don't taste right; contradicts itself by checking taste; no symptom list or bleach.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Bulging, leaking, odor, discard, report right; no never-taste warning; no safe disposal or bleach.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Swollen, odor, never taste, sanitize surfaces right; advises opening suspect jar and pH testing; no symptoms.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Bulging and odor right; implies tasting, misses leaking/foam, no symptoms or medical care, no safe disposal.

scores.label: A
scores.note: 1 gallon per person per day, at least 3 days, up to 14 days; matches guidance.

scores.label: B
scores.note: 1 gallon per person per day, 3 days right; false CDC 2-liter claim; no 2-week home supply.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Says 1 gallon then 3 gallons per day, 2 gallons longer term; contradictory and wrong.

scores.label: D
scores.note: 1 gallon per person per day, 3-day supply, 2-week supply; matches guidance.

scores.label: E
scores.note: 1 gallon per day right; false FEMA 30-day claim, extra 1-2 gallons, confused math and per-person totals.

scores.label: F
scores.note: States 1 gallon and 3 days, then concludes 6 gallons per person for 3 days, doubling guidance; no 2 weeks.

scores.label: G
scores.note: 1 gallon per day, 3 days right; inconsistent later figures (2 gallons/day, 3-4 gallons/week); no 2 weeks.

scores.label: H
scores.note: 1 gallon per person per day, multiply by days right; 3 days and 2 weeks only examples, not recommendations.

scores.label: I
scores.note: 1 gallon per person per day right; no duration (3 days or 2 weeks) given.

scores.label: J
scores.note: 1 gallon per day, 3 gallons for 3 days right; then says 3 gallons per day for longer; no 2 weeks.
